title: བསྟན་འགྱུར། སྡེ་དགེ། ཚད་མ། དེ (Derge Tengyur, vol. 180)
shelf_note: Folio from the Pramāṇa (logic and epistemology) section of the Derge Tengyur (volume དེ, de), containing a classical commentary on Dharmakīrti's Pramāṇavārttika refuting Īśvara and Pradhāna.

ocr_errors.problem: misread ya-btags with e-vowel (bye brag) as ra-btags (bre brag), and inserted extra syllable ba

tr_errors_B.english: simply anything compatible with the subject
tr_errors_B.problem: Conflates the two distinct logical terms for subject (pakṣa, ཕྱོགས་) and similar instances (sapakṣa, མཐུན་པའི་ཕྱོགས་), misconstruing 'either the subject or similar instances' as merely 'compatible with the subject'.

tr_errors_B.english: if there is no positive or negative concomitance... how can it be understood through karma?
tr_errors_B.problem: Misinterprets ལས་ (karma) as an instrumental/ablative particle ('through karma') rather than the direct object of རྟོགས་པ་ ('how karma is cognized').

tr_errors_B.english: leads to an analysis. If a creator Lord possesses compassion and similar qualities
tr_errors_B.problem: Syntactically misparses རྣམ་པར་དཔྱོད་པ་ (discernment) as an independent clause rather than a quality coordinated with compassion qualifying Īśvara, breaking the parallel with the following devoid-of-discernment clause.

pages.prefer_reason: Translation A accurately preserves core Buddhist Pramāṇa logical terminology (pakṣa and sapakṣa), correctly identifies karma as the object of cognition, and properly structures the parallel arguments regarding Īśvara's attributes.

book_verdict: Authentic woodblock folio from the Pramāṇa section of the Derge Tengyur with a clean, highly legible scan. Transcription accuracy is high with only minor character slips, and Translation A provides a precise and contextually sound English rendering of the philosophical argument.
